item.title: Introduction to Blockchain(A short guide on how it works)
item.description: Blockchain Blockchain in simple words is a distributed(decentralized) digital ledger(block) which contains records of various transactions The transactions are recorded in various computers(also called nodes) so that the data can’t be manipulated easily.
